content:
Asha R.: Quick heads-up — final on-site loop for SRE candidate (IC3) landed on Tue 1:00pm PST. Need: panel confirm, debrief scribe, and rubric owner. Candidate has a laptop accessibility note (keyboard only). Can folks confirm or swap?
Kai M.: I can make 1pm PST. tagging @Liam O. for rubric owner?
Liam O.: I can own rubric + weigh infra reliability section. Happy to scribe if needed but prefer rubric owner.
Zoe H.: I can scribe debrief if Liam takes rubric. Also — reminder: candidate requested keyboard-only format for the hands-on. Do we have spec for that?
Asha R.: Great — plan: Liam = rubric owner, Zoe = scribe. Kai = panel. Still need one more panelist for debugging exercise. @recruiting-bot pull from panel pool?
recruiting-bot: Scheduled interview block created: https://recruiting.example.com/interview/1713456789. Panel slots: Asha R., Kai M., Liam O., open. Please confirm within 24h.
Kai M.: I can cover the debugging exercise too if no other takers.
Zoe H.: Question on debrief flow — do we use the short-form rubric (5 bullets) or full scorecard?
Liam O.: Use short-form for loop (timebox). I'll put main anchors: reliability, incident debugging, postmortem logic, system design tradeoffs, communication. Scores 1-5 with notes field.
Asha R.: Plan for candidate accommodations: keyboard-only shared workspace + extra 10m for the exercise. Zoe — I'll DM details for the steps.
Zoe H.: Got it. For transcript consent, candidate already signed via the form.
Kai M.: Two small asks: 1) can we get the test harness commands up front? 2) Where to store debrief notes?
Asha R.: Test harness: run in the vm with this command:
```
./run_debug_shield.sh --keyboard-mode --timeout 30m
```
Store debrief notes in the hiring drive under /interviews/SRE/1713456789/debrief.md — Zoe, I'll give edit access.
Liam O.: I'll prep two targeted prompt questions for the postmortem section and drop them in the drive by EOD.
Zoe H.: I have the slot. I'll start the debrief doc during the interview and fill notes. Will ping if anything comes up.
Asha R.: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Quick checklist I pushed to the calendar invite: 1) join 10 mins early 2) headset check 3) allow extra 10m for keyboard-only 4) rubric anchors in doc.
Kai M.: Sounds good. If no other panelist joins, I'm good to cover the debugging exercise.
recruiting-bot: Reminder: panel confirmation deadline in 20 hours.
Asha R.: Closing loop — if anyone needs to swap, reply here. Otherwise I'll update invite and access tonight.
